# FabricOps Starter Kit documentation navigation

Use these pages in order. This file is a navigation surface for AI agents and documentation tooling; the linked pages own the product definition, workflow, and technical detail.

1. [Product overview](index.md): What FabricOps is, who it supports, what it includes, and where to go next.
2. [How FabricOps Works](how-fabricops-works.md): Three-workspace architecture, notebook responsibilities, metadata handoffs, production promotion, and consumption.
3. [Guided Demo](guided-demo.md): Canonical step-by-step execution order for what to create, configure, open, run, and inspect.
4. [Notebook Templates](notebook-templates.md): Notebook responsibilities, downloads, and implementation handoff.
5. [Metadata Reference](reference/metadata.md): Metadata table purposes, schemas, and ownership.
6. [DQ Rule Reference](reference/dq-rules.md): Supported data-quality rule types and parameters.
7. [Function Reference](reference.md): Public callable behaviour and implementation detail.
8. [Maintainer documentation](maintainer/index.md): Release and repository maintenance guidance. The [Product Definition](maintainer/product-definition.md) owns canonical terminology, workflow, and product meaning.

The repository [README](https://github.com/Voycepeh/FabricOps-Starter-Kit/blob/main/README.md) provides repository-level orientation. The [Public API & Architecture guide](maintainer/public-api-architecture.md) documents the supported callable boundary and call-flow contracts.
